desc: Derive the winning-coordinate reduction: the matching problem is equivalent to selecting \(2K\) cakes, assigning each a coordinate, requiring every coordinate count even, and maximizing assigned coordinate values.
Develop a rigorous near-greedy/parity-correction algorithm from the unconstrained top-\(2K\) solution, including a proof for constant-size corrections.
Establish correctness proofs, complexity bounds, and 64-bit integer requirements for the final algorithm.
